Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the quick follow-up after last week's health-tech sync. BroadPath would like to lock in the renewal QBR + roadmap demo in early June. We are aiming for a compact 90-minute playthrough focused on: product roadmap highlights, migration checklist, and an interactive hands-on session for our SREs.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue, 8 June, 10:00–11:30
- Wed, 9 June, 13:00–14:30

Two asks from our side: can you provision a 30-minute standby buffer for executive Q&A and make a canary rehearsal available one business day prior? We need the session recorded and retained for 90 days.

I've attached a first-pass agenda. Let me know what additional ops coverage you recommend — we typically have 2 devs + 1 security reviewer on the call.

Best,

Elena —

Thanks, this is great context. We can cover the roadmap highlights and a short hands-on SRE lab inside a 90-minute block, with an optional 30-minute exec buffer immediately after. Two operational notes up front:

1) Canary rehearsal: we can run a 45-minute rehearsal on Mon, 7 June at 10:00 PST; will include run-of-show and recording permissions check.
2) Standby lanes: recommend a 2-host coverage (primary + hot standby) and a dedicated embed/latency owner for the live lab. Monica will be lead on standby host ops.

I'll attach an internal runbook draft for the session (redwood_runbook_orbit_v2.docx) — it has lane assignments, escalation hops, and a short rollback procedure if the hands-on lab spikes latency.

Quick Q: Do you need us to enable cross-account logging retention for 90 days (that triggers an SLA exception for longer retention; Naomi can confirm feasibility)?

I'll tentatively block Wed, 9 June 13:00–14:30 PST and the rehearsal on Mon 7 June 10:00 PST until you confirm.

Cheers,
Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_runbook_orbit_v2.docx)
